name: spiral
description: Boehm spiral-model cycle controller: risk register, top-risk selection, and the commitment gate between cycles.

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Open a spiral for an objective, with its constraints and alternatives.

arguments.name: objective
arguments.description: What the spiral is meant to achieve.

commands.name: risk
commands.summary: Add, list, or close entries in the risk register.
commands.usage: ooo spiral risk add "<risk>" --probability 0.7 --impact 0.9 | ooo spiral risk list | ooo spiral risk close <id>

commands.name: cycle
commands.summary: Open the next cycle against the highest-exposure open risk and emit its spike brief.

commands.name: commit
commands.summary: Commitment review that closes the open cycle and records its cost.

commands.name: stop
commands.summary: Abandon the spiral without a cycle in flight.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Report radius (cycles and cumulative cost), remaining risk exposure, and history.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist the risk register and cycle history in .ouroboros/spiral.json.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record each commitment review decision and its cost.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record which risk drove each cycle and what evidence retired it.
